issues.reason: Agent Dashboard grouping and group badges; memory means remembering which project a card belongs to. The one comment discusses planned design, without resource measurements.

issues.reason: Same orchestration message injected twice during 500 ms before delivered_at is stamped. An in-memory guard is proposed; no accumulating memory or resource measurement is reported.

issues.reason: Global macOS Ctrl/Cmd remap request; memory means keyboard muscle memory. The author explicitly calls their patch untested.

issues.reason: Measured 12 park-verdict flips per~30 s for 13.5 min on SSH, followed 80 s later by 3 renderer reloads; heap 60–97 MB is modest and causal linkage is unproven. Maintainer suggests 1.4.168 retest. Current later 17009 damps 1 s bursts, so its presence does not establish coverage of 2.5 s slow flips.

issues.title: [Bug]: crash frequently
issues.reason: Renderer crashed exit 5 on 1.4.170 after 2.1–2.7 GiB measured JS heap.2142 openFiles serialize to~3.9 MiB and whole sampled store~6.2 MiB; counts alone do not explain the GiB heap.11 terminal buffers estimated~9.4 MiB, no browser guests. issues.title: [Bug]: Daemon headless emulator is pinned to 5,000 scrollback rows, so revealing a hidden pane truncates any larger configured scrollback
issues.reason: Configured 50 k renderer scrollback is allegedly replaced by 5 k daemon history on reveal. Memory is the acknowledged cost of increasing retention; the defect is lost history, not excessive retained growth.

issues.title: [Bug]: Agent pane sessions torn down repeatedly (session-exited code 0) — moving .git aside kills the session within ~1s
issues.reason: Seven session teardowns, with a measured~1 s .git rename trigger for a subset; memory pressure is explicitly described as an abandoned diagnosis. Reports missing termination cause, not accumulating resources.

issues.title: [Bug]: Cookie import can temporarily clear active authenticated sessions until restart
issues.reason: Cookie import clears live cookies before some replacements can load and stages 81 for restart; authentication returns after restart. Memory describes cookie residency, not OOM or failed allocation.

issues.title: [Bug]: Orchestration worker terminals stay open after settle (Done stack / retained legacy_ambiguous) — no auto-release
issues.reason: Initial 22 live terminals/21 workers and~3.95 GB session RSS; automation comment measures 9 completed Codex processes alive for days and~540 MB recovered. Later 161/162 and 124/127 retained records have no live terminal, separating stale bookkeeping from cost. Final 3 live terminals are user_owned and can still act; settled dispatch is insufficient authority to kill them. Root 19388 ownership/policy review overlaps.

issues.title: [Feature]: Collapse all / expand all for the sidebar sections
issues.reason: Sidebar collapse/expand-all request; in-memory refers to already loaded sections and cheap set clearing. No resource incident.

issues.reason: Directory-scoped GH_TOKEN not inherited by UI subprocesses; proposed account binding may use a short-lived token cache. Full spec/comments identify existing PR 13664 and its remaining Projects/identity scope; no memory growth report.

issues.title: Feature: Local multi-agent group conversation (shared room across agents)
issues.reason: Local multi-agent conversation rooms; memory only appears in a related project-group feature description.

issues.title: [Bug]: dispatch --inject creates a lane that worker-show, worker-read and worker-list cannot see, and cannot be upgraded

In-memory DB is the test fixture, not a leak measurement. Source review comments reject unconditional supervision because it changes authority over hand-started panes.

issues.title: Browser cookie import from Chrome 150 fails to decrypt on Linux (XDG secret portal, no encrypted_key in Local State)
issues.reason: Linux Chrome key source prevents cookie decryption; memory load 1 OK/21 failed describes import success, not allocation pressure. No resource growth.

issues.reason: Application handshake timeout despite WebSocket 101. Additional environment-rm Unknown environment exception overlaps root 20995/reporter PR 21048; in-memory references describe stale state, not retention magnitude.

issues.title: [Bug]: three defects in the iOS emulator exec passthrough
issues.reason: Exec stdout type errors, camera argument routing and stale skill documentation. memory-warning is a simulator command name; reported kill control explicitly leaves no orphan helper.

Requests ACP/one-shot/leader policy, not an identified Orca heap leak. Current TUI catalog still uses Grok positional-prompt interactive launch.

Current mobile hook has exact/glued/image transcript reconciliation from 14936/17783; latest symptom needs a remaining-path reproduction before calling this an unfixed heap leak.

issues.reason: F 2/Enter file rename shortcut and registry discoverability; memory means muscle memory.

issues.reason: Packaged Windows Gitea auth differs from dev; process env snapshot and session cache are explanatory state. No increasing cache or memory-cost observation; environment-staleness conclusion belongs to the reporter.

issues.reason: Editor scroll/cursor restoration fails across tab switches. Body itself identifies a 20-entry LRU, and memory means non-durable state, not unbounded cache.

issues.reason: Claude per-account last-known usage disappears on switch/restart and OAuth failure. Complains cache expires after 30 min and requests longer persistence. Comments identify 18732 token-refresh fix, remaining error rows, and corrected limited non-active statusline scope.

issues.title: [Bug]: Renderer compositor thread spins at ~100% of one core for hours, producing no frames - recovered by minimize/restore
issues.reason: Measured renderer Compositor~1 core while JS/GPU idle; minimize/restore returns healthy under same TUI load.4781 samples show stable 66–99 MB JS heap.42 h onset is estimated from thread averages; mixedDPI is unproven. Treat as CPU/frame-scheduling incident, not JS memory leak.

issues.title: [Feature]: Per-session MCP policy so ephemeral one-shot agent runs don't inherit the full MCP kit
issues.reason: Measured 28 MCP-related processes/~1.4 GB resident beneath 2 Claude+1 Codex sessions. Configured external process overhead is real but no Orca heap retention mechanism or universal safe disable policy is shown.

issues.reason: Hidden delivery/reveal restoration loses recent transcript output; disabling gate is described as a memory-cost workaround. Candidate abandon routes are unproven for incident; preserving lost bytes is correctness scope, not leak evidence.

issues.reason: Codex 0.149 UserPromptSubmit reportedly holds stdin open and ignores declared 10 s timeout. This explains conditional waiting, not unbounded byte growth or a verified current Codex behavior; bounded actual generated-script control is a useful next proof.

issues.reason: Pairing dropdown forgets explicit Thunderbolt interface after restart/dropout; in-memory cache location explains persistence behavior, not resource growth.

issues.reason: Resource Manager only attributes local processes; requests selected-host diagnostics.memory sampling with no remote kill. Existing PR 8394 noted. Host visibility gap matters to incident interpretation, but body supplies no OOM/leak observation.
